questions.questionText: CSS is a style sheet language used to:
options: Inform the browser how to present a document
questions.correctAnswer: Inform the browser how to present a document
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inform the browser how to present a document.

questions.questionText: In a Web page, the HTML document defines the ______ while CSS defines ______.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Content; how elements are displayed.

questions.questionText: CSS is a mechanism for adding style such as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Fonts, colors, and spacing.

questions.questionText: CSS versions are denoted as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) CSS1, CSS2, CSS3, CSS4.

questions.questionText: CSS3 is divided into multiple documents called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Modules.

questions.questionText: Drafting of the first CSS3 drafts started in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) June 1999.

questions.questionText: The general syntax of CSS consists of selector, property, and:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Value.

questions.questionText: In CSS, a selector is:
options: The HTML element for which style is specified
questions.correctAnswer: The HTML element for which style is specified
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The HTML element for which style is specified.

questions.questionText: A property in CSS is:
options: The type of style to be applied to the selector
questions.correctAnswer: The type of style to be applied to the selector
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The type of style to be applied to the selector.

questions.questionText: A property and its value are separated by a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Colon.

questions.questionText: Multiple property-value pairs within a declaration block are separated by a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Semicolon.

questions.questionText: The declaration block is enclosed within:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Curly braces { }.

questions.questionText: Multiple selectors sharing the same style are grouped using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Commas.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a relative unit in CSS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) em.

questions.questionText: The em unit is relative to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The font-size of the selector.

questions.questionText: The ex unit refers to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The x-height of a font.

questions.questionText: The px unit specifies:
options: Size in pixels relative to the screen
questions.correctAnswer: Size in pixels relative to the screen
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Size in pixels relative to the screen.

questions.questionText: 1 inch equals how many centimeters?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 2.54.

questions.questionText: 1 point (pt) equals:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 1/72 of an inch.

questions.questionText: 1 pica (pc) equals:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 12 points.

questions.questionText: If font-size is set to 120% for an h1 element, the size appears:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 20% greater than the current size.

questions.questionText: line-height: 200% means the height of the line is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Double the normal height.

questions.questionText: How many types of style sheets exist in CSS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Three.

questions.questionText: Which are the three types of style sheets?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Inline, internal, external.

questions.questionText: An inline style is defined using the:
options: style attribute within an HTML element
questions.correctAnswer: style attribute within an HTML element
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) style attribute within an HTML element.

questions.questionText: An internal style sheet is defined using the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <style> element.

questions.questionText: Internal styles are placed inside the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <head> section.

questions.questionText: The type attribute of the <style> element is set to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) text/css.

questions.questionText: Internal style sheets are useful when:
options: Styles apply to a specific Web page
Styles apply to a whole site
questions.correctAnswer: Styles apply to a specific Web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Styles apply to a specific Web page.

questions.questionText: Inline styles:
options: Cannot be reused elsewhere in the page
questions.correctAnswer: Cannot be reused elsewhere in the page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Cannot be reused elsewhere in the page.

questions.questionText: An external style sheet is saved with the extension:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) .css.

questions.questionText: The main benefit of an external style sheet is:
options: Reusability and a consistent look across multiple pages
questions.correctAnswer: Reusability and a consistent look across multiple pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Reusability and a consistent look across multiple pages.

questions.questionText: An external style sheet is linked using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">.

questions.questionText: The rel="stylesheet" attribute specifies:
options: The linked object is a style sheet
questions.correctAnswer: The linked object is a style sheet
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The linked object is a style sheet.

questions.questionText: Which style sheet has the highest priority?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inline.

questions.questionText: A type selector applies styles to:
options: All occurrences of the specified element
Only one element with an id
questions.correctAnswer: All occurrences of the specified element
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) All occurrences of the specified element.

questions.questionText: A class selector matches elements whose ______ attribute is set.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) class.

questions.questionText: A class selector is written with a prefix of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) . (dot).

questions.questionText: An ID selector begins with the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Hash (#) symbol.

questions.questionText: The universal selector is represented by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) * (asterisk).

questions.questionText: The universal selector applies styles to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) All elements in the document.

questions.questionText: An id value should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Unique in a page.

questions.questionText: Which can be applied to multiple elements?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Class.

questions.questionText: Comments in CSS are written between:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) /* and */.

questions.questionText: In the cascade, rules determine which style is applied when:
options: Multiple style sheets define styles for the same element
questions.correctAnswer: Multiple style sheets define styles for the same element
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Multiple style sheets define styles for the same element.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following correctly styles all

elements red?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) p { color: red; }.

questions.questionText: Which CSS rule applies bold to elements with class "note"?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) .note { font-weight: bold; }.

questions.questionText: The modules published by the CSS working group number about:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Fifty.

questions.questionText: CSS4 drafting was started by W3C on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Sep 29, 2009.
